text: A peat pool, black as tea. {lead} dives in, flippers going, and comes up spluttering and delighted with a roll of notes.
A coracle, left on the bank, light as a basket. {lead} gets in and paddles across without spinning more than twice. On the far side: Ammonite.
{lead} tips the wheel over the lip and it bounds off downhill with great purpose. Where it was sitting: Cream Tea.
{lead} circles the flock like it has done this all its life. The gate is clear in a minute. Someone has hung Flask of Tea on the post.
Soft ground, a patient creature, and a lot of worms. {lead} brings up the lot, and under them: Seven-inch Single.
Ripples run out from {lead}'s throw like a good rumour, and the stone raps a reed stem. Something drops out of it: Oak Acorn.
{lead} peers into the water, then pulls out, with great ceremony, a roll of notes.
{lead} circles the flock like it has done this all its life. The gate is clear in a minute. Someone has hung Kendal Mint Cake on the post.
A bale and a bend, and a bowl that wants lofting. {lead} swings and sends it up over the hedge in one long arc. It lands by a roll of notes.
Soft ground, a patient creature, and a lot of worms. {lead} brings up the lot, and under them: Bacon Rind.
A bale and a bend, and a bowl that wants lofting. {lead} swings and sends it up over the hedge in one long arc. It lands by Hag Stone.
{lead} taps out a steady beat beside the hill and the earth begins to wriggle. Turned up with the worms: Wild Garlic.
The old trunk is hollow and ready to go. {lead} heaves, it topples, and out of the hollow rolls Honeycomb.
Ripples run out from {lead}'s throw like a good rumour, and the stone raps a reed stem. Something drops out of it: Drake's Drum.
The little round boat wobbles, then settles. {lead} crosses the water with short, careful strokes and lands among the reeds. There is Victorian Tea Caddy.
{lead} peers into the water, then pulls out, with great ceremony, a few coins.
{lead} taps out a steady beat beside the hill and the earth begins to wriggle. Turned up with the worms: Bacon Rind.
{lead} takes a run up and lofts the bowl clean over the verge. Where it comes down: Cream Tea.
